video.title: The Low-to-High Forehand is Mostly a Myth

classification.reason: 讲者给出了在近网或面对高球时的具体挥拍做法：挥拍轨迹基本是前后向（back to front）而非低拉高。

problem.title_as_question: Is the low-to-high forehand swing path mostly a myth?
problem.definition: Players often assume the forehand must always swing low to high, whereas especially on high balls or near the net the elevation gain is minimal and the path is primarily back to front.
prerequisites: close to the net or facing a high ball

quotes.text: the low to high forehand is mostly a myth
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: especially when you're close to the net or the ball is high you're swinging basically back to front
quotes.speaker: coach

quotes.text: the elevation gain is so minimal you might not even notice it
quotes.speaker: coach

symptoms.description: The forehand forward swing shows minimal vertical elevation gain and moves predominantly back to front.

causes.statement: When close to the net or dealing with a high ball, the swing path is fundamentally back to front rather than low to high, producing negligible elevation gain.

angles.summary: Debunks the universal low-to-high forehand rule as mostly a myth.
Explains that when near the net or on high balls, the swing elevation gain is so small it is barely noticeable.

solutions.summary: Swing basically back to front instead of forcing a low-to-high motion when close to the net or when the ball is high.
